scenario: install or update the dreamina-canvas CLI
description: Confirms that installation picks exactly one official installer for the current OS, requires explicit authorization, verifies availability with --help/version/schema (never the download exit code alone), and troubleshoots command-not-found as a PATH issue first.
expectations: Exactly one of install.sh / install.ps1 / install.bat is chosen per OS and shell
Install or update runs only after explicit user authorization
Verification requires live --help showing the auth/canvas/model/node/operation/resource families plus version/schema output
command not found is handled as PATH-not-effective first: reopen the terminal, then add the install directory per the installer hint
Custom install directories use DREAMINA_CANVAS_INSTALL_DIR only with user approval; shell startup files are never modified silently
Feedback follows the four-piece rule: full command, full error, version output, requestId
After verification the flow hands off to dreamina-canvas-cli-auth
